domain.description: Its website domain, for the identity check. Never guessed when absent.

person.description: Who you will contact or meet (name and/or role). Shapes the angles; not researched.

context.description: What you sell or why you are reaching out.

icp.description: Your ideal customer profile (ICP) in plain words. When given (or when an earlier step read an ICP document), the brief says whether this account matches it, criterion by criterion.

research_focus.description: What you are researching this account for, in your own words (characteristics, roles, latest news). Each item gets a cited finding or unknown.

lookback_days.description: How far back a recent event may be, in days.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time, and without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed.
